name: Hoshimi Hiroko Crystal Clear Soprano v5
prompt: An original young adult Japanese female voice around age nineteen, speaking native standard Japanese. High-pitched, crystal-bright, refreshingly clear girlish soprano with open, ringing bell-like resonance and transparent, unclouded purity — zero breathy veil, zero nasal murkiness, and zero sticky sugariness. Crisp, luminous forward projection, light youthful vocal weight, and natural, sunlit smiling clarity.
